title: Bolivia Ups Diesel Costs for Big Buyers to Tame Supply Shock
summary: Bolivia’s government raised diesel prices 84% for larger consumers of the key industrial fuel, following shortages that caused long lines at gas stations.

title: Guggenheim Rushes to Clarify 77% Earnings Drop After Loan Slides
summary: A financing entity of Guggenheim Investments moved to explain a steep decline in second-quarter earnings after the disclosure sent its loan price tumbling.

title: Hydro-Quebec Inks $36 Billion Energy Deal With Newfoundland
summary: The Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador managed to boost the value of a new 50-year electricity supply agreement with Hydro-Quebec, likely ending a long-running dispute.

title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test

title: EM Currencies Rise on Softer Dollar and Stronger Risk Appetite
summary: An index tracking developing-world currencies gained Monday as fading bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month undercut the dollar and supported risk appetite.

title: We Will Take Risks If Clients Willing: Legum

title: Berkshire-Tracking ETF 'OMAH' Outperforms Company

title: Goldman Sachs to Acquire ETF Provider Neos in $2.3B Deal
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Neil Sipes joins Scarlet Fu and James Seyffart on "ETF IQ." Goldman Sachs will pay as much as $2.25 billion to buy Neos Investments, expanding its asset manager’s reach in the actively managed ETF market. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Casas Bahia Files for Bankruptcy on High Rates, Tight Credit
summary: Grupo Casas Bahia SA filed for bankruptcy protection in Sao Paulo, after an out-of-court debt restructuring with its main creditors proved insufficient to resolve its financial troubles.

title: Saylor’s Strategy Sells More Stock to Repurchase Preferred
summary: Michael Saylor continues to run his Bitcoin accumulation flywheel in reverse.

title: Anthropic Revenue Boom Boosts AI Stocks | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/17/2026
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Global Head of Technology Research Mandeep Singh reacts to Anthropic's revenue report, and news Alphabet is seeking billions in its debut bond offering in Australia. Then, Citi Wealth's Olaolu Aganga joins to discuss AI exposure to investment portfolios, and other AI-related headlines. Plus, Former Biden White House Economics Senior Director Peter Harrell discusses how the War with Iran is making the Trump Administration more hesitant to impose the full power of tariffs as energy costs stay high. Finally, Bloomberg Chief Wall Street Correspondent Sridhar Natarajan talks news that Mark Walter is exploring selling stake in Chelsea FC. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: We Were 'Day One Buyers' Of SpaceX: Cassidy
summary: Lauren Cassidy, CIO of Founders 100 ETF, joins Scarlet Fu and James Seyffart on "ETF IQ." They discuss the fund and how they approach investing in founder-led companies. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Bond Selloff Drives 30-Year Yields to Highest Since 2007
summary: The yield on 30-year US Treasuries hit the highest in almost two decades, reflecting investor angst over surging government spending, a flood of long-dated bond sales and inflation that’s been stuck over the Federal Reserve’s target for the past five years.

title: US Stocks Fall as Rising Oil Prices, Yields Offset Chip Gains
summary: US stocks dropped on Monday as long-term Treasury yields extended their recent climb and oil ticked higher. Chipmakers notched gains as details of Anthropic’s surging sales growth stoked bullish sentiment around AI.

title: Dollar Extends Slide as Traders Scale Back Fed Tightening Bets
summary: The dollar fell to its weakest level in three months as investors scaled back expectations for further Federal Reserve interest-rate increases following a run of softer US economic data.

title: Fmr Pepsico Executive: Consumers Are Being Intentional

title: Stocks Fall as Brent Tops $90 on Middle East Risks: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks joined bonds lower on concern that elevated oil prices will fuel inflation amid dimming hopes for a deal to end the Iran war.
